title: Separate native-command exit capture before PowerShell receipt composition
failure_signature: PowerShell rejected an assignment expression that mixed a native Git command and an if statement before any replay child executed.
candidate_workaround: Run each native command separately, capture LASTEXITCODE immediately, and construct the receipt object only after all command statements finish.
recurrence_guard: Never embed statement lists inside a PowerShell assignment expression when native-command exit state is required.
rollback: Retain the parser failure, award no evidence, keep the target lane unchanged, and retry only with separately validated statements.
scope_boundary: This method validates command transport and evidence accounting only; it does not validate the later replay results.
